args.title: Fix issue 4405 in src/components/ExportButton.tsx
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The ExportButton component defaults the export format state to "csv" and does not remember the last selected format across page visits. To fix this, the code should persist the last chosen format in browser storage (like localStorage) and initialize the button with the stored value.

The ExportButton component defaults the export format state to "csv" and does not remember the last selected format across page visits. To fix this, the code should persist the last chosen format in browser storage (like localStorage) and initialize the button with the stored value.
